import React, { useState } from "react"; import { motion } from "framer-motion"; import { Droplets, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, Clock, MapPin, Phone, Plus, Filter, Search, } from "lucide-react"; import Notifications from "../components/common/Notifications"; const HospitalDashboard = () => { const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("overview"); const [inventoryFilter, setInventoryFilter] = useState("all"); // Mock data for blood inventory const bloodInventory = [ { type: "A+", quantity: 15, status: "available", expiry: "2024-03-15" }, { type: "A-", quantity: 8, status: "low", expiry: "2024-03-10" }, { type: "B+", quantity: 12, status: "available", expiry: "2024-03-18" }, { type: "B-", quantity: 3, status: "critical", expiry: "2024-03-05" }, { type: "AB+", quantity: 7, status: "available", expiry: "2024-03-12" }, { type: "AB-", quantity: 2, status: "critical", expiry: "2024-03-03" }, { type: "O+", quantity: 20, status: "available", expiry: "2024-03-20" }, { type: "O-", quantity: 18, status: "available", expiry: "2024-03-19" }, ]; // Mock data for emergency requests const emergencyRequests = [ { id: 1, patient: "John Doe", bloodType: "B-", quantity: 2, status: "new", priority: "high", time: "2 min ago", }, { id: 2, patient: "Jane Smith", bloodType: "O+", quantity: 1, status: "matching", priority: "medium", time: "15 min ago", }, { id: 3, patient: "Robert Johnson", bloodType: "AB+", quantity: 3, status: "fulfilled", priority: "low", time: "1 hour ago", }, ]; // Mock data for nearby hospitals const nearbyHospitals = [ { id: 1, name: "City General Hospital", distance: "2.5 km", bloodTypes: ["O+", "B+"], status: "available", }, { id: 2, name: "St. Mary Medical Center", distance: "4.2 km", bloodTypes: ["A+", "O-"], status: "limited", }, { id: 3, name: "Regional Blood Bank", distance: "6.8 km", bloodTypes: ["A-", "B-", "AB+"], status: "available", }, ]; const getStatusColor = (status) => { switch (status) { case "available": return "text-green-400 bg-green-500/20 border border-green-500/30"; case "low": return "text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-500/20 border border-yellow-500/30"; case "critical": return "text-red-400 bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/30"; case "new": return "text-blue-400 bg-blue-500/20 border border-blue-500/30"; case "matching": return "text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-500/20 border border-yellow-500/30"; case "fulfilled": return "text-green-400 bg-green-500/20 border border-green-500/30"; default: return "text-gray-400 bg-gray-500/20 border border-gray-500/30"; } }; const filteredInventory = inventoryFilter === "all" ? bloodInventory : bloodInventory.filter((item) => item.status === inventoryFilter); const containerVariants = { hidden: { opacity: 0 }, visible: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1, }, }, }; const itemVariants = { hidden: { y: 20, opacity: 0 }, visible: { y: 0, opacity: 1, transition: { duration: 0.5 }, }, }; return (
